title: Luxe 3 BR Stunner - Sleeps 10 | 662 mbps wifi
description:
Experience Nashville in style! 

This modern 3-story, 3-bedroom home in walkable Wedgewood-Houston is perfect for groups. Enjoy stunning skyline views from 4 private decks, including one with a gas fireplace. Just minutes from Broadway, The Gulch, Geodis Park and The Truth music venue.

Comfortably accommodates your entire crew with a chef's kitchen and spacious living areas.

The space
A 3 story modern construction boasting 3 bedrooms, 3 full baths, 4 decks, and a 3rd floor outdoor natural gas fireplace. 

 In a walkable neighborhood with breweries, distilleries, and coffee shoppes.

Full of well-appointed furnishings, complete with thoughtful touches to make you feel at home.

★ Walkable Wedgewood-Houston, NY Times Top 100 Neighborhood, district of downtown Nashville.
★ Fully stocked kitchen featuring a large island and bar seating
★ Living room with patio access, sleeper sofa and 65" smart TV
★ Bedroom 1: King bed with ensuite bathroom with walk in glass shower
★ Bedroom 2: Two Queens bed with ensuite bathroom with garden soaking tub
★ Bedroom 3: Queen bed with ensuite bathroom with garden soaking tub
★ All bedrooms feature walk-in closets

Guest access
Guests will have exclusive and private access to the entire 3-story home, including all four decks and patios. Enjoy complete privacy during your stay. Keyless entry provides seamless self-check-in.

Parking is convenient with space for up to four cars in the driveway. Additional free street parking is also available.

Other things to note
★ This is a 3-story home with stairs required to access the different levels and bedrooms.
 
★ The kitchen is fully equipped with pots, pans, dishes, silverware, and modern appliances for all your cooking needs.

★ Enjoy the city skyline from four separate decks, including the third-floor deck with a cozy natural gas fireplace.
